route_note: Take a train or express bus south from Hanoi to Ninh Binh, then a short taxi or bicycle ride to the Tam Coc and Trang An boat docks.

route_note: Express limousine buses run directly from Hanoi to Ha Long in about 2.5-3 hours; day cruises depart from the Tuan Chau or Bai Chay piers.

route_note: Frequent trains and express buses connect Hanoi with Hai Phong in roughly 2-2.5 hours; from the city a local bus or taxi reaches Cat Ba ferry piers.
